title: Large-sample causal profitability/meta-filter development
purpose: Build a sufficiently large causal candidate dataset and freeze one profitability/meta-filter specification before any future fresh holdout is created.

acceptance_boundary.hy_exp_0028_holdout_policy: It may be cited as development context only; it cannot be used as an independent validation, holdout, or promotion result for HY-EXP-0030.

data_sources.provider: Binance public USD-M Futures APIs and append-only public market-data capture
data_sources.depth: Prospective REST depth snapshot plus diff reconstruction; historical rows require native depth provenance and are excluded if unavailable.
data_sources.availability_rule: Before outcome reads, audit each required stream for full-window coverage, native timestamps, point-in-time universe membership, PIT instrument rules, funding, and executable-price/depth fields. Missing required coverage fails closed; no current-state backfill, interpolation, OHLCV depth proxy, or survivorship repair.

expanded_universe.selection: At each decisionTime, rank PIT-eligible USDT perpetuals by prior six completed 4h quote volume, retain the top 50 after the fixed liquidity/depth checks, and always retain the eight baseline symbols when eligible.
expanded_universe.depth_check: Require native reconstructed L2 best spread <= 15 bps and >= 250000 USDT displayed notional within 10 bps; missing depth fails eligibility.

universe.survivorship_policy: Membership is evaluated from PIT listing/status records at decisionTime; current symbol lists cannot add or remove historical membership.

HY-EXP-0028-BULL-BUY.semantics: Use the frozen HY-EXP-0028 Bull/BUY candidate generator exactly; do not alter Q75, universe, entry, exit, or thresholds.

HY-EXP-0030-BEAR.regime_formula: BTCUSDT completed 4h close < its prior 180 completed 4h SMA AND at least 62.5% of the PIT-eligible universe closes below its own prior 180 completed 4h SMA.
HY-EXP-0030-BEAR.breakdown_formula: Candidate symbol completed 1h close < the lowest low of its immediately preceding 120 completed 1h bars; the current bar is excluded from the channel.
HY-EXP-0030-BEAR.persistence: One completed 1h close below the channel is sufficient; no outcome-dependent persistence change is allowed.
HY-EXP-0030-BEAR.entry: First valid executable 5m ask after decisionTime and no later than 5 minutes; otherwise INVALID_CANDIDATE.
HY-EXP-0030-BEAR.exit: Fixed 24-hour forward mark using causal executable bid observations; no post-outcome exit selection.

SIDEWAYS.rule: If neither the frozen Bull/BUY rule nor the frozen Bear/SELL rule passes at decisionTime, emit context only and no candidate.

warmup.insufficient_history: NO_CANDIDATE; do not shorten warmup or backfill missing feature history.

feature_snapshot.availability: Every feature is captured and frozen at decisionTime or earlier; missing, late, non-finite, or non-PIT input invalidates the row.

features.channelDistance: Signed distance in bps from the prior 120-bar Donchian boundary, positive in the candidate direction.
features.atrPercent: ATR(30) of completed 1h true ranges divided by decision close, expressed as percent.
features.realizedVolatility: Standard deviation of prior 24 completed 1h log returns multiplied by sqrt(24), expressed as percent.
features.trendSlope1h: OLS slope of prior 24 completed 1h log closes, expressed in bps per hour.
features.trendSlope4h: OLS slope of prior 30 completed 4h log closes, expressed in bps per 4h bar.
features.btcAlignment: Sign agreement between candidate and BTC prior 24h log return; -1, 0, or 1.
features.relativeStrengthVsBTC: Candidate prior 24h log return minus BTC prior 24h log return, in bps.
features.volumeExpansion: Current completed 1h quote volume divided by the mean of the prior 24 completed 1h quote volumes minus 1.
features.fundingRateAtDecision: Latest realized funding rate with fundingTime <= decisionTime; no forward funding value.
features.fundingChange: Latest settled funding rate minus the immediately preceding settled funding rate, both available by decisionTime.
features.distanceFromRecentHighLow: For the candidate direction, signed bps distance from the highest high/lowest low of prior 24 completed 1h bars.
features.breakoutPersistence: Count of the last 3 completed 1h closes beyond the prior 120-bar directional channel boundary.
features.shortTermMomentum: Prior 6 completed 1h log-return in bps, signed in the candidate direction.
features.marketBreadth: (eligible symbols above SMA60 - eligible symbols below SMA60) / eligible symbols at decisionTime.
features.crossSymbolBreadth: Fraction of eligible symbols with the same directional 1h channel state as the candidate.
features.liquidityDepthProxy: Native L2 displayed notional within 10 bps divided by the candidate notional; never OHLCV or bookTicker depth.
features.volatilityShock: Prior 6 completed 1h realized volatility divided by prior 30 completed 1h realized volatility minus 1.
features.utcHour: UTC hour as sin/cos(2*pi*hour/24); minute is included as a fractional hour.

labels_and_costs.label: Net executable 24-hour forward return after realized funding and the fixed cost schedule; label is unavailable until after the candidate row is frozen.
labels_and_costs.entry_cost_rule: Use observed executable bid/ask/depth at entry; no candle open or midpoint substitution.

model_benchmarks.common_validation: All models are fit only inside each expanding walk-forward training fold and compared only on OOF rows.
model_benchmarks.no_meta_filter: All valid candidates in the fold; fixed equal-risk paper allocation subject to portfolio limits.
model_benchmarks.rule_scorecard: One point for each of the frozen directional feature signs agreeing with the candidate side; accept only score >= 10 of 17, fixed before outcomes.

ridge_logistic.features: All frozen causal features after training-fold standardization and [-3,3] clipping.

model_benchmarks.primary_objective: Net expectancy after costs and portfolio risk, not accuracy or win rate.

walk_forward.ordering: decisionTime ascending, then symbol, then candidateId

portfolio_risk.allocation: Equal risk per accepted candidate, capped at 1% of paper research capital per candidate.
portfolio_risk.portfolio_equity_marks: Use executable bid/ask marks at every 5-minute observation; missing marks invalidate the portfolio segment.
portfolio_risk.unreconstructed_portfolio_risk: FAIL_CLOSED; trade-level adverse excursion/CVaR cannot substitute.
